test.result: 15 passed across the new bridge and existing loss-review tests; Ruff passed.

implemented: Aggregates signed forecast gross, selection, spread, impact, charges, timing, and risk-sizing effects by day.
Requires unique trade identity and finite numeric components; duplicate, malformed, and nonfinite values fail closed.
Marks a day reconciled only when all effects are present and sum to realized net within the declared tolerance.
Exposes missing trade IDs, leaves missing effects null, and reports a nonzero arithmetic residual instead of hiding it.
blockers: The intraday paper ledger does not yet persist all bridge effects or a frozen forecast-gross baseline.
There is no authoritative bridge integration that proves each paper portfolio loss day has complete trade-level inputs.
The bridge validates accounting arithmetic only; caller-supplied counterfactual selection, timing, and sizing effects are not causal evidence.
